The tag suggestions are in at **http://maker:4001** (refresh). Please confirm:

**Adding tags in bulk with suggestions.** Select a few bookmarks and click **Add tags…**. A small panel opens with a text box and clickable chips of your **existing tags** (the same set suggested when saving). Click a chip or type — as you type, the chips filter to match — then **Add**. The tag lands on all selected bookmarks.

**Removing tags in bulk from what's actually there.** Select a couple of bookmarks that share some tags, then click **Remove tags…**. This time the chips show only the tags that **actually occur on those selected bookmarks** (each shown with an ✕), so you don't have to remember or retype them. Pick one and **Remove** — it's stripped from all of them.
